verdict.rationale: The evidence shows an API reference, widgets and SDKs for embedding Canny into the developer's own site or app, Canny-built native integrations, and an MCP server for external AI tools. None of it documents a way for developers to build custom integrations or apps that appear and run inside Canny's own interface. Widget embedding works in the opposite direction, and custom fields are an adjacent feature, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build custom integrations that appear and operate directly inside the product's own interface
